In brick pitches (one pitch = centre-to-centre spacing). Radius is centre to a flat wall.
Display and camera Drag to orbit. Right-drag or shift-drag to pan. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Click a brick to identify it. Keys: arrows pan, + / − zoom, F fits.

Bricks are shown as smoothed visualization meshes of the final SeaBrick design: the connector surfaces are not modelled. Layouts follow the tongue-to-claw lateral-lock rule checked in the design study; detailed clearance and insertion order are still under study.
